categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in ecological protection and environmental governance, focusing on rural environmental management. Its main business includes rural environmental governance engineering services, operation services, consulting services, and integrated sewage treatment equipment sales. It also engages in agricultural non-point source pollution control, rural living environment improvement, ecological restoration, and industrial wastewater treatment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced environmental governance technologies tailored for rural areas, including sewage treatment technologies like MBR, biofilm, activated sludge, and ecological wetland processes. It develops integrated containerized sewage treatment equipment with low energy consumption and automation. The company also employs insect transformation technology for organic solid waste treatment and has patented technologies in microbial agents, soil remediation, and ecological restoration.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are mainly government agencies and state-owned enterprises, particularly local government investment platforms. The company serves rural communities, townships, and counties, focusing on rural living environment, ecological environment, and production environment governance. Major markets include provinces such as Hunan, Hubei, Guizhou, Jiangxi, Sichuan, and Anhui.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Changsha, Hunan Province, with business operations primarily in Hunan and expanding to other provinces including Hubei, Guizhou, Jiangxi, Sichuan, Anhui, Shandong, Yunnan, Zhejiang, Guangdong, Shanghai, Liaoning, Henan, and Shaanxi. It has established subsidiaries and project operations across these regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the environmental protection supply chain, providing integrated environmental governance solutions including engineering design, equipment manufacturing, project construction, operation, and maintenance services. It also invests in and operates environmental infrastructure projects.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding rural environmental governance services, enhancing intelligent sewage treatment equipment manufacturing, and advancing agricultural non-point source pollution control. R&D focuses on insect protein feed production, plant resource utilization, heavy metal wastewater treatment, ecological restoration technologies, and energy-efficient equipment like permanent magnet direct-drive centrifugal fans. The company emphasizes innovation in ecological environment-oriented development and digital technologies such as AI and big data.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through multiple streams including engineering contracting (EPC), operation management services, consulting and design services, product sales (notably integrated sewage treatment equipment), biological product sales, and computing power leasing. The company also earns income from investment operations and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the few listed enterprises in China with comprehensive capabilities in rural environmental governance, holding a competitive position due to its early market entry, extensive project experience, and integrated service offerings. Competitors include small-scale environmental firms, equipment suppliers, and specialized agricultural companies, but few offer the full spectrum of services the company provides.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 184.6 million, a 3.78% increase from 2023, but a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 30.8 million. Total assets reached RMB 1.66 billion, up 14.88% year-over-year. The company’s cash flow from operations improved slightly, and it has ongoing investments and financing activities supporting growth. Despite losses, it maintains a significant asset base and continues to invest in R&D and expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through its comprehensive rural environmental governance solutions, combining technology innovation, integrated engineering services, and operation management. Its patented technologies and customized equipment address the unique challenges of rural pollution. The company’s strong brand reputation, extensive project portfolio, and ability to provide one-stop environmental solutions create significant customer value and competitive advantage.
